name: ANSI/IEEE Latched foot-operated switch form
aliases: IEEE Pedal Switch Latched, Normally Open
summary: IEEE-library form of latched foot-operated switch: this representation distinguishes a foot actuator with a retained operated state.
description: This reference locates latched foot-operated switch in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous switches family. This representation distinguishes a foot actuator with a retained operated state. The public library uses HFT11L for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
